title: Store values with make
objective: Keep a value in a named variable, and change it later.

body.text: Make gives a value a name. A name can only be given a new value if it is made changing, and set then changes it.

body.title: Store and change values
body.code:
make score equal to 10
make changing lives equal to 3
set lives to 2
say "Score: {score}"
say "Lives: {lives}"

body.text: increase adds an amount to a changing number. For example, increase score by 5 adds 5 to score. Setting a name that was not made changing is a compile error, so the compiler tells you before the program runs.

body.prompt: score starts at 0 and never changes, so the program prints Score: 0. Make it print Score: 5.
body.starter:
make changing score equal to 0
say "Score: {score}"
body.solution:
make changing score equal to 0
increase score by 5
say "Score: {score}"
